svg.title: Original Edulytiks graph comparison for Algebra 2 Unit 2 Lesson 18
svg.desc: Four coordinate graph panels for rational functions of the form c plus a divided by x, on x from negative eight to eight, with x equals zero excluded. A has horizontal asymptote y equals four and matches expressions c and h. B has y equals negative four and matches b and e. C has y equals one and matches d and g. D has y equals negative one and matches a and f. A red dashed horizontal line marks each asymptote. Blue curves are the rational branches. This is original first-party artwork based on mathematical functions, not publisher artwork; not yet integrated into student rendering.

g.aria-label: Panel 1: A: y = 4 + 1/x; source equivalent formulas c, h
Panel 2: B: y = -4 + 1/x; source equivalent formulas b, e
Panel 3: C: y = 1 + 4/x; source equivalent formulas d, g
Panel 4: D: y = -1 + 4/x; source equivalent formulas a, f

svg.text: BLUE: function; RED DASHES: horizontal asymptote. x = 0 is excluded in every panel. Original Edulytiks draft, not deployed.
